Madam Chair, members of the school board, Dr. Cashwell, colleagues, and guests. Tonight, we are honored to be here to recognize our 2024 Winter State Championship team, continuing Henrico County's tradition of athletic excellence in the state of Virginia.

I would like to invite swim team head coach Steve Gromling and assistant coach Ryan Densley, along with the members of the 23-24 Douglas Freeman Boys Swim and Dive team, Nicholas Kurger, Nathan Zabota, and Blayne Nelson to come forward.
It is with immense pride that we stand before you today to celebrate the remarkable achievements of the Douglas Freeman swim and dive team in the 23-24 season.

In a display of unparalleled skill and dedication, our team emerged undefeated in Region 5C, securing our fourth regional championship title. Not stopping there, we went on to clinch our third VHSL state championship title.

marking a historic moment for Douglas Freeman High School. What makes this season unique is the introduction of diving to our program, a first in Henrico County history. At the state championship, Douglas Freeman dominated with a total of 295 points across all events, finishing with an impeccable 16-0 overall record.

Freeman not only claimed multiple regional and state titles, but also earned the prestigious title of All-American. Our individual Region Champions are, in the 200 medley relay, first place, Nathan Zabota, Nicholas Kuriger, Alex Ayers, Henry Brooks, in the 200 freestyle earning first place, Nathan Zabota, in the 500 freestyle first place, Nathan Zabota, and in the 400 freestyle relay, first place, Leif Martin, Caleb June, Cole Nelson, and Nathan Zabota.

The individual state championships are in the 200 medley relay, a new state record and an All-American A, Nathan Zabota, Nicholas Kuriger, Alex Ayers, and Henry Brooks. In the 200 freestyle, first place, All-American C, Nathan Zabota.

In the 100 butterfly, first place, Alex Ayers. And in the 500 freestyle, first place, an All-American A, Nathan Zabota. As well as this, the overall team GPA is a 3.95, displaying academic excellence as well.

In closing, I extend my heartfelt congratulations to each member of the Douglas Freeman Swim and Dive team, their coaches, their families, and supporters. These achievements are a reflection of the unwavering support and dedication of the entire Freeman family.
